messages:
maya: Heads up — EU GPU swarm is failing to join after the firewall mTLS cert rotation. Seeing keystore handshake errors and audit-shipper drops.
sam: Oof. How many nodes? impact to customers?
maya: ~18 nodes stuck in provisioning, 4 already evicted from warm pool. No customer-facing 5xx yet but higher queue times.
liam: Can you paste the error from the node agent logs?
maya: ```
2026-03-22T08:41:12Z agent[pid=2345]: keystore: handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-22T08:41:12Z agent[pid=2345]: audit-shipper: dropped events, err=unauthorized
2026-03-22T08:41:13Z provisioning: gpu-node join timeout (keystore auth)
```
natalie: Looks like the mTLS cert rotation pushed a new CN that our keystore proxy ACLs don't accept.
derek: Confirmed — keystore proxy logs show blocked CNs from the rotation window. Related to the patch that tightened SAN checks.
oncall-sre: tagging infra oncall @sam @liam @derek — need a rollback or allowlist quickfix.
liam: Can we add a temporary allowlist for the new CNs? Ops-bot, what's the rollout window on that rotation?
ops-bot: Deployment 2026-03-22T07:50:00Z rolled cert-rotation:v2 to eu-keystore-proxy (50% -> 100%)
sam: If it's already 100% we should fallback keystore proxy to v1 config. Is there a safe flag for SAN lax mode?
derek: There is a feature-flag but it's gated by infra-approval. I can patch a one-line to accept the additional SANs — doing now.
maya: Patch applied, restarting proxy on eu-rt1.
liam: Restart command?
derek: ```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/eu-keystore-proxy --context=eu-rt1
``` 
natalie: Restarted on eu-rt1, seeing reconnects.
maya: Nodes are reattempting join. First 5 joined, warm pool +3.
liam: Still seeing some audit drops in shipper — maybe stale auth token caching.
derek: Flushed proxy auth cache, should clear short-lived tokens.
oncall-sre: Monitoring queue times + p95 latency. No customer visible errors yet.
maya: All 18 nodes joined successfully at 08:48 UTC. warm pool back to target.
sam: Follow-up items: 1) Rollback SAN-strict patch until we've verified keystore compatibility. 2) Add canary step to cert rotation runbook for region-bounded fleets. 3) Add better telemetry on cert CN mismatches so joins are actionable.
liam: Also let's add a short-lived allowlist mechanism for rotations (ops-only toggle) — we almost needed full rollback.
natalie: Filing a postmortem doc and runbook PR. I’ll include the log snippet and a timeline.
maya: Thanks. Putting incident label: "keystore-mtls-rotation-eu-gpu-join". Will link the postmortem.
sam: Good catch, everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-eu-mtls-01 (assigned to eng-sre)
